verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It establishes the orbit-centralizer formula for the conjugation action, shows that every noncentral conjugacy class has size divisible by p, and applies the class equation to conclude that p divides |Z(G)|. Since the identity lies in Z(G) and p is at least 2, the center contains a nonidentity element. The statement is self-contained, all stated hypotheses are used, no hard prohibition is triggered, and no external or fact-graph references require checking.
